title: GDevelop + AI
author: Individual_Record521
selftext:
G develop is a no code game engine that definitely requires more work than using a pure AI game engine but actually very easy to get into and start developing games if you don't know any code. 

What I found recently switching to g develop is that if you use AI like Brock or chat GPT to help guide you in g develop you can actually start to make really fast progress almost better than the AI game engines. 

You develop offers multiplayer functionality a built-in market great support and very intuitive controls for building pretty nice games. 

If you haven't looked into it I'd recommend it
